name: ai-coding-setup
description: Prompts, skills, and scripts for driving AI coding agents through review and git workflows.

plugins.name: ai-coding-setup
plugins.description: The review and git workflow commands: /commitmsg, /code-review, /code-refinement, /dependency-review, /review-pr, /git-history-cleanup and /efficient-orchestration.

plugins.name: explore-agent
plugins.description: The Explore subagent pinned to haiku by a shadowing agent definition. For sessions without function hooks; explore-model supersedes it where those are on. Installing both gives you neither's benefit.

plugins.name: explore-model
plugins.description: An agent.spawn function hook that pins the Explore subagent to a cheap model, so background codebase searches stop billing at the main session's tier. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: review-gate
plugins.description: The review gate as a tool.check function hook: every shell call decided in process, the script spawned only for a command that could commit, and a blocked commit put to you as a question rather than refused. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 and bin/review-gate installed.
